description: Implement next, take, context, progress, finish, and release as MCP tools wrapping AgentWorkflow. take passes the server session id so a restarted server auto-adopts. context keeps section/cursor/limit paging, fields projection, and remains the way to re-read claim_token and next_action after a client restart. finish is model-assert only. The E_MULTIPLE_CLAIMS envelope carries every offending item id and its claim token in recovery, and claims stays in the default profile so the hot path can self-recover. Choose the byte cap and context default limit together.

preserves.behavior: A restarted server re-adopts its own claim via same-principal adoption
One live claim per principal; claim-token generation checks on progress, finish, release
finish never executes a stored shell command (ADR 0003 2.4)

work_units.evidence: Confirmed AgentWorkflow return shapes and E_MULTIPLE_CLAIMS hard-fail on next/take via current_claim
work_units.summary: Confirm AgentWorkflow return shapes and the E_MULTIPLE_CLAIMS hard-fail on next and take

work_units.evidence: Implemented 6 tools (next/take/context/progress/finish/release) plus claims via FastMCP, worker dispatch, envelope, dbpool with pinned GitScopeEngine and session
work_units.summary: Implement the six tools with the envelope and worker-thread dispatch

work_units.evidence: E_MULTIPLE_CLAIMS envelope now carries item ids and claim tokens in recovery via _claims_for_principal; claims tool stays in default profile
work_units.summary: Make the E_MULTIPLE_CLAIMS envelope carry item ids and claim tokens; keep claims in the default profile
